Setting Up the Phone

How we set up a new Samsung so it is ready for accounts. Every account starts here. Watch the video first, then follow this step by step, every time.

Version v0.1Updated 10 Nov 2026Owner KTool Samsung phone · hotspot
Download PDF

01Watch first

Setting up a Samsung for the first time. Watch it once for the flow.

⚠ Read this before you watchThis video is NOT how we do it. It is only here so you see the flow and what the screens look like. Where the video and this SOP are different, this SOP wins. Follow the steps below, every time.

Video not playing? Open it here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0bgKh1Z6gc8

02What this is

Every account lives on its own phone. The phone has to look like a normal person's phone: no Samsung account, nothing shared, nothing linked. When it's set up, the Gmail is next (SOP: Creating a Gmail), then Instagram, Facebook and Threads.

⚠ The rules that get accounts banned

NEVER CONNECT THE PHONE TO WI-FI. HOTSPOT ONLY.

NEVER DOWNLOAD A PICTURE FROM GOOGLE DRIVE ONTO THE PHONE. ALWAYS OPEN IT AND TAKE A SCREENSHOT.

The apps can see where a picture came from and how the phone connects. Break one of these and the account gets banned.

03Before you start

  • The Samsung, charged, with its SIM card in.
  • A hotspot you can use: your own phone, or another work phone.
  • The company login sheet open on your laptop.

04Step by step

1

Welcome: English (United States)

Tap the language. Choose English (United States), not United Kingdom. Press Start.

2

For your review

End User Licence Agreement and Privacy Policy: ticked. Sending of Diagnostic Data: leave it empty. Don't press Agree to all. Press Next.

3

Set up manually

Don't copy anything from another phone. Press Set up manually.

4

Wi-Fi: Skip

It shows Wi-Fi networks. Press Skip. Never connect to any of them.

5

Google sign in, screen lock: Skip

Google sign in: Skip. Protect your phone (face, fingerprint, PIN, password): Skip.

The screen lock can be done later.

6

Google services: turn everything off

Every toggle off: Use location, Allow scanning, and everything under them. Press More until you reach the end, turning each one off.

7

No Samsung account

Don't open a Samsung account. Don't give any information. Press Skip if you see it. If you don't: press Forgot password or don't have an account?, then continue and skip. Skip everything until you're on the home screen.

8

Connect to a hotspot

On the home screen: Settings → Wi-Fi → connect to the personal hotspot of another phone. That's the only connection this phone ever uses.

9

Download and update the apps

Open the Play Store. Download or update Gmail, Instagram, Facebook and Threads, plus anything else the phone asks to update. Nothing else.

The company account isn't logged in on the Play Store? Message K on Telegram.

05Done means

  • The phone is on the home screen and has never joined a Wi-Fi network.
  • No Samsung account. Diagnostic data off. Every Google toggle off.
  • It's on a phone's hotspot.
  • Gmail, Instagram, Facebook and Threads are installed and up to date.
  • Next: SOP Creating a Gmail.

06Common mistakes

  • Connecting to the office Wi-Fi "just for a second". Never.
  • English (United Kingdom) left as the language.
  • Pressing Agree to all, which ticks diagnostic data.
  • A Google toggle left on. Check them all.
  • Making a Samsung account. Skip it.

Added after every review with K
